accueil.iginiMention: helps you analyse, build, fund, grow and pass on your project — all from one place. Truth above all.

analyser.description: Summary, feasibility score, strengths, risks, next steps.

construire.description: Build plan: milestones, estimated timeline, key resources.

financer.description: Funding plan: estimated budget, sources, spending items.

developper.description: Growth plan: levers, key indicators, scaling risks.

transmettre.description: Transfer plan: handover options, documentation, checklist.

memoire.description: What IGINI remembers of your decisions, preferences and lessons learned.

connaissance.description: A graph of concepts linking the ideas of your project together.

workflow.description: IGINI's suggestions become trackable tasks — never carried out on your behalf.

score.description: An honest dashboard of your progress, with no invented figures.

accueil.communauteTexte: Make a project public when you are ready and receive encouragement from other project owners — nothing more for now, no private messaging and no rankings.
accueil.pret: Ready to bring your idea to life?
